# anthropic_skill (Data Source)

Get information about a single Skill by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_skill" "example" {
  id = "skill_xxxxx"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) ID of the Skill.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 datetime when the Skill was created.
- `display_title` (String) Display title of the Skill.
- `latest_version` (String) Latest version identifier of the Skill.
- `source` (String) Source of the Skill (`anthropic` or `custom`).
- `updated_at` (String) RFC 3339 datetime when the Skill was last updated.
